description.content:
POST /v3/getReport

This request generates the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV). It returns all the information associated with vendor items that are set up on Walmart's platform.

query.description:
(Required) Specifies the type of report. Use `type=vendor_item` to fetch the item report from drop ship vendors (DSV). Example(s):
vendor_item

(Required) Specifies the version used to get the latest version of the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV).

Use `version=2` to access the latest version of the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV).

Example(s):
2

header.description:
Specifies an identifier that tracks the consumer request by channel.

Use the consumer channel type received during onboarding.

See the system administrator or developer management for the `WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE` value.

(Required) Specifies an identifier for each API call and is used to track and debug issues.

 This may be any value, but cannot be null or omitted.
(Required) Specifies the access token retrieved in the Create Access Token request. This value is required for token-based authentication.
